title: Multi-Order Passive Macromodeling from Layouts via Nested Port-Hamiltonian Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compact, passive state-space macromodels of interconnects and power-delivery networks are essential for stable transient signal- and power-integrity simulations. However, conventional flows require costly per-layout full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulations, while both traditional fitting and prior learning surrogates rely on post-hoc fitting or passivity perturbation that degrades accuracy without guaranteeing convergence. In this work, we propose an end-to-end macromodeling framework that learns directly in the passive space, mapping physical layout graphs to multi-order port-Hamiltonian (pH) macromodels. Specifically, our network encodes each layout graph into unconstrained matrix blocks and assembles them via a complete, prefix-nested pH parameterization that guarantees continuous-frequency passivity and stability by construction, yielding valid $k$-state macromodels via direct state slicing in one forward pass. translated_title: 基于嵌套端口哈密顿学习的版图多阶无源宏建模
translated_abstract: 互连与电源分配网络的紧凑无源状态空间宏模型对于稳定的瞬态信号完整性与电源完整性仿真至关重要。然而，传统流程需要对每个版图进行代价高昂的全波电磁（EM）仿真，而传统的拟合方法和已有的学习代理模型都依赖于事后拟合或无源性扰动，这不仅会降低精度，还无法保证收敛。在本工作中，我们提出了一种端到端的宏建模框架，直接在无源空间中进行学习，将物理版图图映射为多阶端口哈密顿宏模型。具体而言，我们的网络将每个版图图编码为无约束的矩阵块，并通过完整的前缀嵌套pH参数化将其组装起来，该参数化在构造上即保证了连续频率下的无源性与稳定性，通过一次前向传播中的直接状态切片即可生成有效的k状态宏模型。为训练所有阶……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种直接在无源空间中学习的端到端宏建模框架，利用前缀嵌套的端口哈密顿参数化，从物理版图图一次性生成在构造上即保证无源性与稳定性的多阶宏模型，从而免去了逐版图昂贵且耗时的全波电磁仿真。
en_tdlr: An end-to-end macromodeling framework that learns directly in the passive space, mapping layout graphs to multi-order port-Hamiltonian macromodels whose continuous-frequency passivity and stability are guaranteed by construction via prefix-nested pH parameterization, eliminating costly per-layout full-wave EM simulations.
